script.title: HELP AT THE SELF-CHECKOUT
script.scene_zh: 賣場自助結帳 · 機器卡關
script.story_hook: The self-checkout yells, and nobody comes.
script.intro_zh: 自助結帳機一直響，卻沒有人過來。
script.welcome_en: Hey there, glad you're here! Today we handle the self-checkout machine.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，很高興你來！今天我們對付自助結帳機。
script.outro: You made it through! Listen once more and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 你順利走完全程！再聽一遍，跟著唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Ready? Say each line just like the audio.
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好了嗎？照著音檔一句一句唸。
script.char_a_description: a bearded man in his mid thirties with a faded blue beanie over buzzed hair, wearing a gray university hoodie and jeans, shifting his weight from foot to foot
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her fifties with shoulder-length silver hair in a loose braid, wearing a maroon store polo and black slacks, jangling keys on her belt loop

script.youtube_title_en: “Item In The Bagging Area!” — Getting Help at a Self-Checkout
script.youtube_description:
自助結帳機一直叫，尷尬到想逃跑？這段超真實的解圍對話讓你從容結帳！在賣場的自助機台前，跟著 Noah 一起呼叫店員、完成年齡確認、補掃漏掉的商品。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就會開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Self-checkout screaming 'unexpected item' while you stand there frozen? This real supermarket rescue dialogue has you covered. Follow Noah as he calls the attendant, passes the ID check, and re-scans the missed bananas — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. The second half is line-by-line repeat practice to make it stick.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
youtube_tags: how to ask for help in English
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🛒自助結帳英文｜請店員協助・年齡確認・補掃商品｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
機器一直響，英文卻一句也說不出口？
「物品在裝袋區」到底發生了什麼事？

這一集帶大家走進賣場的自助結帳區，Noah 的機台不停亂叫，從請店員協助、配合藥品年齡確認，到想起漏掃的香蕉，每一步都是真實場景。

你會聽到：
🔔 請店員協助：例如「Excuse me, it says item in the bagging area.」。
🪪 年齡確認：例如「cold medicine needs a quick age check」、「card or license, either works」。
🍌 補掃與結帳：例如「did you scan those first」、「one tap and you're done」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次機器再亂叫，深呼吸，叫店員過來，一句搞定！
script.thumbnail_action: raising a hand to call the attendant

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, it says item in the bagging area.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː ɪt sɛz ˈaɪtəm ɪn ðə ˈbæɡɪŋ ˈɛriə/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，它一直顯示「物品在裝袋區」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that voice! What did you scan?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt vɔɪs wʌt dɪd ju skæn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那個聲音！你掃了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just chips and a soda, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tʃɪps ənd ə ˈsoʊdə ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 只有洋芋片和一瓶汽水，別的沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, this machine loves false alarms here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðɪs məˈʃiːn lʌvz fɔːls əˈlɑːrmz hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It froze again. Now it wants my ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt froʊz əˈɡɛn naʊ ɪt wɑːnts maɪ ˌaɪˈdiː/
dialogue.zh: 它又當機了。現在要我出示身分證？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, cold medicine needs a quick age check.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛə koʊld ˈmɛdsɪn niːdz ə kwɪk eɪdʒ tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 對，感冒藥要做簡單的年齡確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, I totally forgot about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt aɪ ˈtoʊtəli fərˈɡɑt əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 噢對了，我完全忘了這回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, card or license, either works.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜːriz kɑːrd ər ˈlaɪsəns ˈiːðər wɜːrks/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，信用卡或身分證都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my card. Is my birth date okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz maɪ kɑːrd ɪz maɪ bɜːrθ deɪt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的卡。我的出生日期沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it only reads the year, don't sweat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪt ˈoʊnli riːdz ðə jɪr doʊnt swɛt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，它只讀年份，別緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, this screen scares me every single time.
dialogue.phonetic: /fjuː ðɪs skriːn skɛrz miː ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 呼，這螢幕每次都會嚇我一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bananas — did you scan those first, by chance?
dialogue.phonetic: /bəˈnænəz dɪd ju skæn ðoʊz fɜːrst baɪ tʃæns/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I never weighed them at all!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ aɪ ˈnɛvər weɪd ðɛm ət ɔːl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, mystery solved! One tap and you're done.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈmɪstəri sɑːlzd wʌn tæp ənd jʊr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，謎團解開了！點一下就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You fixed that faster than I could blink.
dialogue.phonetic: /juː fɪkst ðæt ˈfæstər ðæn aɪ kʊd blɪŋk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happens all day, friend. You're all paid now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpənz ɔːl deɪ frɛnd jʊr ɔːl peɪd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一整天都在這樣啦。你現在結帳完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you truly; you saved my whole evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk juː ˈtrʊli juː seɪvd maɪ hoʊl ˈiːvnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 真的很感謝，你救了我整個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Next time the machine will behave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm nɛkst taɪm ðə məˈʃiːn wɪl bɪˈheɪv/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！下次機器就會好好配合了。
